mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM student
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND name_kana LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nameKana}, '%')
AND email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (name, name_kana, nickname, age, gender, place_of_residence, email, remark, is_deleted) VALUES (#{name}, #{nameKana}, #{nickname}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{placeOfResidence}, #{email}, #{remark}, false)
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET name=#{name}, name_kana=#{nameKana}, nickname=#{nickname}, age=#{age}, gender=#{gender}, place_of_Residence=#{placeOfResidence}, email=#{email}, remark=#{remark}, is_deleted=#{isDeleted} WHERE id=#{id}
